name: Keiji no Mappadaka
source:
Very largehearted fellow, doesn't pay trifles any mind. Peeny's lover, and he always look on very fondly at his boyfriend's snarky tsuntsun. His trouble is that his gigadick is too enormous. Wears an orgasming elephant mask over his crotch.
